verdict.summary: Round 3 confirms the v0.3.0 pin is aligned between the workflow and harness default/example, while AGENTS.md and the audit-readiness dossier accurately distinguish the pinned tag from CI evidence. The harness's real path consumes XPATH_TAG when generating its Nargo dependency, runs the oracle tests, and performs per-test-function fault injection, so the non-vacuity claim remains supported. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is present in the diff.
